payload.text: At cc's About-reader commit (decision 10), check: one reader serves every About read (tree.rs, grep.rs, sync.rs --pull, tags.rs twice) and tree.rs's aliases read; non-UTF-8 decodes lossily; a read error other than NotFound fails the command naming the path, returned to the coordinator; --pull names the real cause; the two tests run red then green; no golden changed. Then amend WP14's body to drop its fourth edge case, and vc's clean-clone run. It lands before WP13.
